tts: This program takes a messy drug entry and cleans it, one string tool at a time.
The comment says what the program does.
The entry has extra spaces at both ends and a small first letter. Look at the Variables panel: the spaces are inside the quotes.
strip removes the spaces from both ends. Then capitalize makes the first letter a capital. The clean text is saved in drug.
print shows the clean entry.
len counts every character, including the space in the middle. That makes seventeen.
The slice takes the first four characters, A M O X, and upper turns them into capitals. That's a short code for the label.
replace swaps two fifty M G for two fifty, space, M G. Notice that drug itself didn't change: replace gave a new string.

tts: Here is a batch code from a medicine strip.
Every character has an index, starting from zero. The year starts at index four.
The slice four to eight takes indexes four, five, six and seven. It stops just before eight.
Those four characters make the year: two zero two six.
And the program prints it on the label.
display: Here is a batch code from a medicine strip.

The slice four to eight takes indexes four, five, six and seven. It stops just before eight.
Those four characters make the year: two zero two six.
And the program prints it on the label.

tts: यह medicine strip का एक batch code है।
हर character का एक index है, जो zero से शुरू होता है। साल index चार से शुरू होता है।
Slice चार से आठ, index चार, पाँच, छह और सात लेता है। यह आठ से ठीक पहले रुकता है।
ये चार characters मिलकर साल बनाते हैं: दो zero दो छह।
और program इसे label पर print करता है।

tts: ಇದು ಒಂದು medicine strip ನ batch code.
ಪ್ರತಿ character ಗೂ ಒಂದು index ಇದೆ, zero ಇಂದ ಶುರು. ವರ್ಷ index ನಾಲ್ಕರಿಂದ ಶುರು ಆಗುತ್ತೆ.
Slice ನಾಲ್ಕರಿಂದ ಎಂಟು, index ನಾಲ್ಕು, ಐದು, ಆರು ಮತ್ತು ಏಳು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೆ. ಎಂಟಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಮುಂಚೆ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತೆ.
ಈ ನಾಲ್ಕು characters ಸೇರಿ ವರ್ಷ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ: ಎರಡು zero ಎರಡು ಆರು.
ಮತ್ತು program ಇದನ್ನು label ಮೇಲೆ print ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ.
